description: Decentralized collectives using open-weight models begin publishing designs for simple gene circuits and protein binders via encrypted academic forums and dark-web repositories, inspired by the bio_uplift_findings signal. These are not yet viable pathogens but represent a distributed, unregulated frontier in bioengineering. The activity evades detection by blending into open science discourse and leverages EU-based compute due to laxer oversight on academic clusters, creating a jurisdictional blind spot.
